title: Finite-type and Noetherian geometry of the affine-line support pair
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put $X=\mathbf A^1_Y$ with projection $p:X\to Y$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Let $s:Y\hookrightarrow X$ be the zero section, defined on each affine open $\operatorname{Spec}R\subset Y$ by the quotient $R[t]\to R$, $t\mapsto0$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $U=X\setminus s(Y)$ with its open subscheme structure and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be the inclusion [def-weil-open-immersion]; over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ this is the principal open $\operatorname{Spec}(R[t]_t)$, also denoted $\operatorname{Spec}R[t,t^{-1}]$. Then $X$ and $U$ are of finite type over $k$, the three schemes $Y,X,U$ are Noetherian, and $j$ is quasi-compact. Here Noetherian means locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact, with quasi-compactness of schemes and morphisms understood as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

proof.text: The spectrum of the field is Noetherian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to the structure map Y to Spec k: LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian supplies local Noetherianity and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace supplies compactness. Together these construct IsNoetherian Y.

proof.text: By [def-sbc-affine-space], lineProjection is the relative affine-space projection for the finite singleton coordinate type. Mathlib.AffineSpace supplies LocallyOfFinitePresentation for this projection, hence LocallyOfFiniteType, and IsAffineHom, hence QuasiCompact. These are the polynomial-chart finite-type properties in the definition. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to the projection over Y to construct IsNoetherian (Line Y). Composing the projection with the structure map of Y by [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change](1) gives finite type over k.

Agent-extracted geometric prerequisite; Stacks Morphisms Tag 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian) and Properties Tags 01OW (lemma-locally-Noetherian), 01OX (lemma-immersion-into-noetherian) supply the Noetherian and quasi-compact inputs.

proof.text: The map openImmersion Y is the canonical inclusion of the coordinate basic open and is an open immersion by [def-weil-open-immersion]. Since Line Y is locally Noetherian, this inclusion is quasi-compact by Stacks 01OX, realized by AlgebraicGeometry.instQuasiCompactOfIsLocallyNoetherianOfIsOpenImmersion in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Noetherian. Concretely, the inverse image of any affine open W is an open subscheme of the Noetherian affine scheme W, so is Noetherian and compact by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian]. This replaces the unnecessary coordinate-localization calculation.

By [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type], the complementary immersion is locally of finite type and quasi-compact. The definition puncturedProjection Y = openImmersion Y followed by lineProjection Y and [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change](1) give finite type of the punctured projection over Y and then over k. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to the punctured projection over the Noetherian scheme Y to construct IsNoetherian (Punctured Y). Assemble these properties with those obtained above.
